title: 割代价与平衡
Cut cost and balance
subtitle: 少切连线，也要放得下
Cut fewer connections, and keep the parts usable
summary: 从一条跨组连线开始，区分目标函数、节点数平衡与面积容量。
Start with a crossing edge. Separate the objective, node-count balance and area capacity.
author: GateUltra
hook: 把合作最密切的人分到两间办公室，会发生什么？
What happens when close collaborators are assigned to different offices?
objectives: Compute a weighted cut edge by edge
检查分组是否完整且互斥
编写可测试的指标函数
terms: 节点 / vertex
电路单元；带有正的面积 size。
A circuit cell with a positive size.
边权 / weight
一次跨组连接的非负代价；本实验要求正权。
The cost of a crossing connection; this lab uses positive weights.
割代价 / cut
所有跨组无向边的权重之和，每条只算一次。
The sum of crossing undirected edge weights, each counted once.
容量 / capacity
每个分组所容许的最大面积和。
The maximum total area allowed in one part.
可行 / feasible
满足完整分组、非空与规定容量。
A complete assignment with nonempty parts and the stated capacity.

title: 初始二分
Initial bisection
subtitle: 先得到一个合法的起点
Build a legal starting point
summary: 比较随机、顺序贪心与区域生长；记录种子、平票和人数上限。
Compare random, sequential greedy and region growing with explicit seeds, ties and count limits.
author: Capeur
hook: 组队先抽签，还是先找合作最多的人？
Should teams start with a draw, or with the strongest collaborators?
objectives: 复现有种子的随机分组
解释区域生长的候选分数
Apply count limits and tie rules
Assess the limits of several starts
terms: 构造 / construction
从没有分组开始建立分组。
Building an assignment from scratch.
种子 / seed
控制伪随机序列的整数。
An integer controlling the pseudorandom sequence.
增量 / increment
当前决定对已分配节点造成的新跨边代价。
The new crossing cost to already assigned nodes.
区域生长 / region growing
从一个锚点逐步吸收连接最强的未选节点。
Expand an anchored part using connection strength.
平票 / tie
分数相等时采用预先声明的确定性规则。
Equal scores resolved by a declared deterministic rule.

title: Kernighan–Lin 二分
Kernighan–Lin bisection
subtitle: 成对试探，保留最佳前缀
Try pairs, then retain the best prefix
summary: 完整运行成对交换、锁定、增益更新和回退，理解负增益试探。
Run pair selection, locking, gain updates and rollback; understand negative-gain trials.
author: muranfei
hook: 挪动一对座位，为什么要先试完再决定保留哪几步？
Why try a sequence of seat exchanges before deciding which ones to keep?
objectives: 解释累计增益与空前缀
Explain cumulative gain and the empty prefix
区分试探状态与接受状态
说明人数不变不等于面积不变
Explain why counts fixed does not mean areas fixed
terms: D 值 / D value
节点跨组边权减同组边权。
External minus internal edge weight.
增益 / gain
cut_before − cut_after，正数表示改进。
cut_before − cut_after; positive means improvement.
锁定 / lock
本 pass 中不再选择已试探的节点。
A tried node cannot be selected again in this pass.
pass
从初始状态开始，选择互不重复的候选直到无法继续。
A sequence of disjoint trial choices from a pass start.
最佳前缀 / best prefix
累计增益最大的最早前缀，允许空前缀。
The earliest prefix of maximum cumulative gain, including the empty prefix.

title: Fiduccia–Mattheyses 二分
Fiduccia–Mattheyses bisection
subtitle: 收益最大，还必须合法
The highest gain must also be legal
summary: 一次移动一个节点；先过滤平衡约束，再排序、锁定并回退。
Move one node at a time. Filter by balance before ranking, locking and rollback.
author: stephQ-lab
hook: 电梯里最想出去的人，为什么还不能先出去？
Why might the person most eager to leave the lift have to wait?
objectives: 维护锁定与受影响增益
用 pin 数解释超边增益
Explain net gains using pin counts
区分教学实现与线性复杂度结论
Separate this teaching implementation from the linear-time claim
terms: 合法候选 / legal move
移动后两侧非空，节点数差不超过 maxDiff。
Both sides remain nonempty and count difference is at most maxDiff.
FS
一条 net 在节点原侧的 pin 数。
Number of pins of a net on the moving node's from side.
TE
一条 net 在目标侧的 pin 数。
Number of pins of a net on the target side.
gain bucket
按增益值组织候选；本实现用 Map 并扫描合法节点。
Candidates indexed by gain; this implementation uses a Map and scans legal nodes.
回退 / rollback
撤销最佳前缀之后的所有试探。
Undo every trial after the best prefix.

title: 谱二分
Spectral bisection
subtitle: 先排成一列，再寻找切口
Order the vertices, then sweep the cut
summary: 实时构造拉普拉斯矩阵、求解 Fiedler 向量并扫描合法切口。
Build the Laplacian, solve for a Fiedler vector live and sweep legal thresholds.
author: thy031
hook: 把连接紧密的节点拉近，怎样得到一条可切开的队列？
How can strong connections produce a line of vertices that is easier to cut?
objectives: Verify row sums and the quadratic form
Recognize the limits of the relaxation
terms: 拉普拉斯 / Laplacian
L=D−A，D 是加权度的对角矩阵。
L=D−A, with weighted degrees on D's diagonal.
Fiedler 向量
与第二小特征值对应的特征向量。
An eigenvector for the second smallest eigenvalue.
残差 / residual
‖Lx−λx‖/‖x‖，检查数值求解质量。
‖Lx−λx‖/‖x‖, a check of numerical solution quality.
扫描 / sweep
按特征向量值排序，逐个前缀试切。
Sort by eigenvector value and test each prefix.
简并 / degeneracy
相关特征值相等，向量方向不唯一。
Repeated eigenvalues make the vector direction non-unique.

title: 递归二分
Recursive bisection
subtitle: 一刀接一刀，也要记住整张图
Split repeatedly while accounting for the whole graph
summary: 每次选择当前最大组，在其诱导子图上重新二分，记录全图新增割边。
Split the largest current part on its induced subgraph; account for new cuts on the full graph.
author: xingguangyaoyu
hook: 分完两队再分小组，先前的边界还算不算？
When two teams split into smaller teams, do the old boundaries still count?
objectives: 解释非 2 的幂的 k
Handle k that is not a power of two
识别局部平衡与最终容量差异
Separate local balance from final capacity
terms: 诱导子图 / induced subgraph
保留指定节点以及两端都在其中的边。
The chosen vertices and all edges with both endpoints in that set.
叶子 / leaf
当前仍作为一个分组的子问题。
A current part that can still be split.
分裂树 / split tree
记录每个父组如何产生两个子组。
A record of each parent part and its two children.
新增割 / added cut
一次分裂导致的全图 cut 增量。
The increase in full-graph cut caused by a split.
局部约束 / local constraint
只作用于当前二分，未必保证所有最终组的容量。
A rule for the current split, not a guarantee on every final part.

title: 多路划分
Multiway partitioning
subtitle: 比较 k 个分组与交换改进
Compare k parts and refine them by swaps
summary: 同图比较轮转、递归二分与容量合法的跨组交换；用小图精确解校准。
Compare round robin, recursive bisection and capacity-legal swaps; calibrate against a tiny exact oracle.
author: FanqinZeng
hook: 把五个任务轮流发给三个人，工作量公平就足够了吗？
If five tasks are handed out round robin to three people, is fairness enough?
objectives: 比较递归构造与交换改进
Compare recursive construction and swap refinement
解释局部最优和精确解差距
设计同输入的公平比较
terms: k 路 / k-way
把节点划分到 k 个互斥非空组。
Assign vertices to k disjoint, nonempty parts.
轮转 / round robin
第 i 个节点分到 i mod k。
Assign vertex i to i mod k.
交换改进 / swap refinement
每步执行一个严格正增益且容量合法的跨组交换。
Accept a strictly improving, capacity-legal cross-part swap.
局部最优 / local optimum
当前邻域中没有改进，不等于全局最优。
No improvement in the chosen neighborhood; not a global guarantee.
精确枚举 / exact oracle
小图枚举全部合法分组，用于校准与验证。
Enumerate legal tiny assignments for calibration and tests.
